correctness.rationale: For independent replacement depolarization after CNOT, Pauli masses are a=1-3p/4 for I and b=p/4 for each X,Y,Z. At p=(8-2sqrt6)/5, inspected 15 explicitly weighted affine supports from decomposition.json. Independently rebuilt all 16 exact Q(sqrt6) target Choi diagonal masses and convex mixture; verified each weight positive and total 1, each support affine, and all 19 pairs of restricted stabilizer generators commute on its declared bipartition. Each projector is diagonal in local joint eigenbases, hence separable on declared SEP, SEP-with-SWAP or EB cut. Local post-depolarization preserves each operation class, extending to every p>=p*. Distinct numerical PPT spot-checks support nontriviality but are not certification. No global optimality claim.

value.rationale: A rigorously checked, fully explicit 15-state separability mixture improves a physical gate-noise sufficient threshold from 66.67% to 62.02% in exactly the original gate-level model. It is a concrete reusable separability certificate with exact algebraic coefficients, not an unsupported decimal gain.

limitations: Gate noise convention is independent local replacement on each output qubit; certificate concerns convex-hull bi-entangling class, not a tight threshold.
